options.content:
## AI-Assisted Code Adoption
Tracks commits whose message carries an **AI co-author trailer** (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Devin, Gemini, aider). Percentages are over **human-authored** commits (bots/Renovate excluded).

> ⚠️ **This is a floor, not the true number.** The trailer only appears when a developer's tooling is configured to emit it; many disable it and squash-merges can drop it. Actual AI usage is higher than shown.

panels.description: Share of human-authored commits in range that carry an AI co-author trailer.

targets.rawSql:
select round(100 * sum((is_claude or is_copilot or is_cursor or is_oracle or is_devin or is_gemini or is_aider)) / nullif(count(*),0), 2) as "AI-assisted commit %"
from (
  select distinct
    c.sha, c.authored_date, c.additions + c.deletions as churn, c.author_email, c.author_name,
    (c.msg like '%noreply@anthropic.com%')                                        as is_claude,
    (c.msg like '%Co-authored-by: Copilot%' or c.msg like '%copilot-swe-agent%')  as is_copilot,
    (c.msg like '%Co-authored-by: Cursor%')                                       as is_cursor,
    (c.msg like '%oracle-agent@bonial.com%')                                      as is_oracle,
    (c.msg like '%Co-authored-by: Devin%')                                        as is_devin,
    (c.msg like '%Co-authored-by: Gemini%')                                       as is_gemini,
    (c.msg like '%Co-authored-by: aider%')                                        as is_aider
  from (
    select sha, authored_date, additions, deletions, author_email, author_name,
           convert(message using utf8mb4) as msg
    from commits
  ) c
  join repo_commits rc on rc.commit_sha = c.sha
  join project_mapping pm on pm.row_id = rc.repo_id and pm.`table` = 'repos'
  where pm.project_name in (${project})
    and $__timeFilter(c.authored_date)
    -- Denominator = engineering commits (humans + AI agents), excluding mechanical bots.
    -- AI-trailer commits are always kept, even when authored by an agent (e.g. 'nobody', copilot-swe-agent[bot]).
    and (
      (c.msg like '%noreply@anthropic.com%'
       or c.msg like '%Co-authored-by: Copilot%' or c.msg like '%copilot-swe-agent%'
       or c.msg like '%Co-authored-by: Cursor%'
       or c.msg like '%oracle-agent@bonial.com%'
       or c.msg like '%Co-authored-by: Devin%'
       or c.msg like '%Co-authored-by: Gemini%'
       or c.msg like '%Co-authored-by: aider%')
      or (
        c.author_name not like '%[bot]%'
        and c.author_name not like '%renovate%'
        and c.author_name not like '%Machine User%'
        and c.author_name not like '%find-and-replace%'
        and c.author_email <> 'bot@bonial.com'
      )
    )
) t

panels.title: Trailer share

panels.description: Per-project AI-co-authored commit counts, adoption %, and churn.

targets.rawSql:
select
  t.project_name                                              as "Project",
  count(*)                                                    as "Human commits",
  sum(t.is_ai)                                                as "AI commits",
  round(100 * sum(t.is_ai) / nullif(count(*),0), 2)           as "AI %",
  sum(case when t.is_ai then t.churn else 0 end)              as "AI lines (churn)"
from (
  select distinct
    pm.project_name,
    c.sha,
    c.additions + c.deletions as churn,
    (convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%noreply@anthropic.com%'
       or convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%Co-authored-by: Copilot%' or convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%copilot-swe-agent%'
       or convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%Co-authored-by: Cursor%'
       or convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%oracle-agent@bonial.com%'
       or convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%Co-authored-by: Devin%'
       or convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%Co-authored-by: Gemini%'
       or convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%Co-authored-by: aider%') as is_ai
  from commits c
  join repo_commits rc on rc.commit_sha = c.sha
  join project_mapping pm on pm.row_id = rc.repo_id and pm.`table` = 'repos'
  where pm.project_name in (${project})
    and $__timeFilter(c.authored_date)
    and (
      (convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%noreply@anthropic.com%'
       or convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%Co-authored-by: Copilot%' or convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%copilot-swe-agent%'
       or convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%Co-authored-by: Cursor%'
       or convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%oracle-agent@bonial.com%'
       or convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%Co-authored-by: Devin%'
       or convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%Co-authored-by: Gemini%'
       or convert(c.message using utf8mb4) like '%Co-authored-by: aider%')
      or (
        c.author_name not like '%[bot]%'
        and c.author_name not like '%renovate%'
        and c.author_name not like '%Machine User%'
        and c.author_name not like '%find-and-replace%'
        and c.author_email <> 'bot@bonial.com'
      )
    )
) t
group by t.project_name
having sum(t.is_ai) > 0
order by sum(t.is_ai) desc
